sororitas-rhino.name: Sororitas Rhino
sororitas-rhino.transport: This unit can transport up to 10 friendly ADEPTUS MINISTORUM INFANTRY models. It cannot transport JUMP PACK models and can only transport ADEPTA SORORITAS models if they have the <ORDER>, DIALOGUS or HOSPITALLER keyword.

immolator.name: Immolator
immolator.transport: This unit can transport up to 6 friendly ADEPTUS MINISTORUM INFANTRY models. It cannot transport JUMP PACK models and can only transport ADEPTA SORORITAS models if they have the <ORDER>, DIALOGUS or HOSPITALLER keyword.

sororitas-repressor.name: Sororitas Repressor
sororitas-repressor.transport: This unit can transport up to 10 friendly <ORDER> INFANTRY models. It cannot transport JUMP PACK models.

ephrael-stern-and-kyganil-of-the-bloody-.name: Ephrael Stern and Kyganil of the Bloody Tears

harlequins-kiss-and-the-outcasts-blades.name: Harlequin's Kiss and The Outcast's Blades

beacon-of-faith.name: Beacon of Faith
beacon-of-faith.text: Improve the Save characteristic (to a maximum of 3+) of friendly ADEPTA SORORITAS units by 1 whilst they are wholly within 6" of this unit.

miraculous-intervention.name: Miraculous Intervention
miraculous-intervention.text: The first time the number of damage markers next to this unit equals its Wounds characteristic, roll a D6; on a 2+ this unit is not destroyed, and one damage marker is removed from it.

healing-tears.name: Healing Tears
healing-tears.text: At the beginning of the Orders phase, you can remove one damage marker from a friendly GEMINAE SUPERIA unit within 3" of this unit.

lead-the-righteous.name: Lead the Righteous
lead-the-righteous.text: Re-roll hit rolls of 1 for attacks made by friendly <ORDER> units whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

simulacrum-imperialis.name: Simulacrum Imperialis
simulacrum-imperialis.text: If any friendly units with this ability are on the battlefield when an Adepta Sororitas Command Asset is played, roll one D12; on a roll of 10+ return that Command Asset to your hand instead of discarding it. That Command Asset cannot be played again this turn.

medicus-ministorum.name: Medicus Ministorum
medicus-ministorum.text: At the end of the Action phase, this unit can attempt to heal one friendly ADEPTUS MINISTORUM LIGHT unit in base contact with it. If it does, roll one D6; on a 4+ remove one damage marker from that LIGHT unit. Only one attempt to heal each unit can be made each turn.

laud-hailer.name: Laud Hailer
laud-hailer.text: You can re-roll Morale tests taken for friendly ADEPTA SORORITAS units whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

bodyguard.name: Bodyguard
bodyguard.text: At the start of the Damage phase, you can select one friendly <ORDER> LIGHT CHARACTER unit that has at least one blast marker next to it and is within 6" of this unit. Remove up to D3 blast markers from that CHARACTER unit and place them next to this unit.

sworn-protectors.name: Sworn Protectors
sworn-protectors.text: You can re-roll hit rolls for attacks made by this unit whilst it is within 6” of any friendly <ORDER> CANONESS units.

banner-of-sanctity.name: Banner of Sanctity
banner-of-sanctity.text: Add 1 to the Leadership characteristic of friendly ADEPTUS MINISTORUM and ASTRA MILITARUM units whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

word-of-the-emperor.name: Word of the Emperor
word-of-the-emperor.text: Re-roll failed Morale tests taken for ADEPTUS MINISTORUM INFANTRY units whilst within 6" of any friendly units with this ability.

lone-mission.name: Lone Mission
lone-mission.text: No more than one MISSIONARY unit can be included in each Detachment.

the-pulpit-of-saint-holline-s-basilica.name: The Pulpit of Saint Holline’s Basilica
the-pulpit-of-saint-holline-s-basilica.text: Improve the Save characteristic (to a maximum of 3+) of friendly ADEPTA SORORITAS INFANTRY units by 1 whilst they are wholly within 6" of this unit.

fiery-conviction.name: Fiery Conviction
fiery-conviction.text: Re-roll hit rolls and wound rolls of 1 for attacks made by friendly ORDER OF OUR MARTYRED LADY units whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

the-fiery-heart.name: The Fiery Heart
the-fiery-heart.text: Friendly ADEPTA SORORITAS units automatically pass Morale tests whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

solemn-procession.name: Solemn Procession
solemn-procession.text: This unit cannot embark aboard TRANSPORTS.

relics-of-the-matriarch.name: Relics of the Matriarch
relics-of-the-matriarch.text:
This unit has three relic abilities. In the Damage phase, after making saving throws for this unit, reduce the number of relic abilities this unit has for each damage marker it has. To do so, select one relic ability this unit has; this unit no longer has that relic ability. If damage markers are removed from this unit, select the relevant number of relic abilities for this unit to regain. This unit’s relic abilities are as follows: 

• Add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made with melee weapons by friendly ADEPTA SORORITAS units whilst they are within 6" of this unit. 
• If this unit is on the battlefield at the start of the Generate Command Assets step, you generate one extra Command Asset.
• Once per turn, instead of making a hit roll, wound roll or saving throw for an ADEPTA SORORITAS unit within 6" of this unit, you can use this ability. That hit roll, wound roll or saving throw is automatically passed (do not roll).

cast-together-by-fate.name: Cast Together by Fate
cast-together-by-fate.text: Ephrael Stern and Kyganil of the Bloody Tears are treated as separate units that take up 1 HQ slot instead of 2. They must be placed at the same time and within 3" of each other the first time they are set up.

daemonifuge.name: Daemonifuge
daemonifuge.text: Add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made with this unit's Daemonifuge whilst it is within 18" of any CHAOS units.

divine-protection.name: Divine Protection
divine-protection.text: Subtract 1 from hit frolls for attacks that target Ephrael Stern.

mysterious-saviour.name: Mysterious Saviour
mysterious-saviour.text: Ephreal Stern has Ignore Damage(6+) whilst they are within 3" of Kyganil.

martyrdom.name: Martyrdom
martyrdom.text: Each time an ADEPTA SORORITAS CHARACTER in this Detachment is destroyed, you generate one Command Asset.

lifewards.name: Lifewards
lifewards.text: At the start of the Damage phase, you can select one friendly CELESTINE unit that has at least one blast marker next to it and is within 6" of this unit. Remove up to D3 blast markers from that CELESTINE unit and place them next to this unit.

driven-onwards.name: Driven Onwards
driven-onwards.text: If an <ORDER> SISTERS REPENTIA unit starts a Move action within 6" of any friendly units with this ability, add 3" to that unit’s Move characteristic whilst making that Move action.

mistress-of-the-penitent.name: Mistress of the Penitent
mistress-of-the-penitent.text: This unit does not take up slots in a Detachment that contains any <ORDER> SISTERS REPENTIA units.

war-hymns.name: War Hymns
war-hymns.text: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of friendly ADEPTUS MINISTORUM INFANTRY and ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY units whilst they are making Fight actions whilst within 6" of any friendly units with this ability.

ecclesiarchy-battle-conclave.name: Ecclesiarchy Battle Conclave
ecclesiarchy-battle-conclave.text: This unit does not take up slots in a Detachment that contains any MINISTORUM PRIESTS.

zealot.name: Zealot
zealot.text: You can re-roll hit rolls for attacks made with melee weapons by this unit.
